name: brightloop
description: Subscription Management System — plans, subscriptions, recurring billing, payments and revenue in one place.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c auto "npm run dev --workspace apps/api" "npm run dev --workspace apps/web"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start --workspace apps/api
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace packages/shared && npm run test --workspace apps/api
